change: reference_resolution_v1: resolve a referring expression to ONE element among look-alikes. Four kinds -- TEXT, SCOPE (anchor then target), RELATION (colour/shape/paint), ORDER (position). Returns RESOLVED / AMBIGUOUS / NOT_FOUND and never a silent guess. Wired into CLICK, FIND and the colour-reference path.

the_audit_that_motivated_it.method: every one of the 20 zero-rate tasks was read and grouped by WHY it failed, not by score
the_audit_that_motivated_it.conclusion: on 7 of 20 the procedure was already known and the actuator clicked a wrong-but-plausible sibling. That is not a learning gap and a demonstration would not close it.

measured.delta: +11 episodes, +5.8 points, CI overlaps but the paired per-task comparison is unambiguous

per_task_attribution.circle-center: 0/5 -> 5/5. The target is an <svg><circle>; every earlier candidate query used HTML selectors and could not see it, so the resolver fell through to the Submit button.
per_task_attribution.click-color: 0/5 -> 3/5. The instruction carries the target colour as PAINT in <div id=query-color>, never as a word. Added a painted-reference matcher: read the swatch from #query, then match the task-area element with equal computed background.
per_task_attribution.count-sides: 0/5 (REFUSED) -> 2/5. The FIND verb had no implementation but was declared, so r142's widened grammar routed goals into it and stopped. FIND now resolves.
per_task_attribution.click-collapsible-2: 0/5 -> 1/5. Links are hidden inside a collapsed jQuery accordion, so the honest answer at time zero is NOT_FOUND. Added expand-then-resolve: open a disclosure, look again.

six_defects_found_by_probing_instead_of_: text_candidates used innerText, which is the whole SUBTREE: a wrapper div whose text is the page matched every word on screen. Now own-text (direct text nodes) is separate from shown text.

THE INSTRUCTION IS NOT THE TARGET: 'click on the link posuere' is itself a text node in #query, so the resolver clicked the instruction banner. Candidates are now restricted to #area and chrome is excluded.

controls with no text have NAMES: social-media renders .reply/.retweet/.like/.report as empty spans; the words in the goal are the class names. Added a declared-name tier (aria-label, title, id, className).
a reference value can be PAINTED: click-color states the target colour only as a styled swatch inside the instruction.
a circle is not a div: SVG figures were invisible to every selector used before.
a verb with no implementation must not SHADOW one that has: FIND was declared, unimplemented, and captured goals that used to reach CLICK.
the_discipline_this_round_imposed: Six wrong patches in a row were written before the page was probed, and each one was plausible. What stopped it was dumping the actual candidates and reading the task source: every defect above was invisible to reasoning and obvious to a DOM dump. The rule recorded: PROBE BEFORE PATCH; a patch written from a hypothesis costs a round and teaches nothing.
what_is_NOT_claimed: that resolution is solved. click-menu still 0/5, social-media still 0/5, hot-cold still 0/5 -- the SCOPE and menu paths are partly wired and partly wrong.
that the three regressions are noise. drag-cube 5/5 -> 3/5 is a real effect of the changed dispatch and has not been diagnosed.
